modules.name: Learn
modules.title: Suffixes Lessons
modules.instructions: Master -al, -ful, -less, -ive, and compound suffixes to understand how words change meaning. Understand how suffixes transform root words into nouns, adjectives, or adverbs.

modules.name: Write
modules.title: Writing Practice
modules.instructions: Write sentences using -ful/-less contrasts, -ly adverbs, and compound suffixes like -friendly or -proof to express precise meanings. Apply suffix rules in real contexts.

modules.name: Play
modules.title: Suffix Games
modules.instructions: Play games to practice choosing between -al/-ic, -ful/-less, and compound suffixes in context. Recognize word formation patterns.

modules.name: Apply
modules.title: Suffixes Challenge
modules.instructions: Apply -hood, -ship, -wise, and -worthy correctly in sentences. Master hyphenation rules for compound suffixes.
